title: Permits, Drawings, Engineering, Lead-Safe Setup and Project Management Fees on Reconstruction Contracts
content:
**Rule.** On a Reconstruction contract, construction starts only after the permit is issued or the building department's no-permit determination is recorded. The contract must be in signed, permitted or in construction status when a permit or professional fee is posted. Municipal permit fees are billed at the cost on the building department's receipt, one line per permit type, and the company's permit expediting fee is billed once per permit type pulled. Plan drawings are billed once per contract when the building department requires drawings, and an engineering letter once per letter when framing is altered; a tier whose fee is 0.00 bills neither. Lead-safe setup is billable only when the building was built before the RRP year-built cutoff and the work disturbs painted surfaces. Lead-safe work follows the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule and is done by the company's certified renovators. Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreements carry a project management fee of the tier's percentage of the contract sum, billed once at construction start.

## Fee lines at a glance

| Fee | When it is billed | How often |
|---|---|---|
| Municipal permit fee | at the cost on the building department's receipt | one line per permit type |
| Permit expediting fee | for each permit type the company pulls | once per permit type |
| Plan drawings | when the building department requires drawings | once per contract |
| Engineering letter | when framing is altered | once per letter |
| Lead-safe setup | building built before the RRP year-built cutoff and the work disturbs painted surfaces | per contract |
| Project management (Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement) | at construction start | once, at the tier's percentage of the contract sum |

On a tier whose plan drawing or engineering letter fee is 0.00, neither is billed.

## Conditions read from the records

- **Status**: the contract record must show signed, permitted or in construction when a permit or professional fee is posted.
- **Year built**: the lead-safe test uses the year built on the contract record. Both parts must hold — built before the cutoff year and work that disturbs painted surfaces.

| Built before the cutoff year | Work disturbs painted surfaces | Lead-safe setup billable |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Construction start

Construction starts only after the permit is issued or the no-permit determination is recorded; issuing the permit or recording the determination moves the contract from signed to permitted, and construction start moves it to in construction.

## Example (hypothetical figures)

A Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement with an assumed contract sum of $240,000.00 and an assumed project management percentage of 3% would carry one project management line of $7,200.00 at construction start.
